summary_en: Annual dividend raised to ¥72/share from ¥70/share (+2.9%). Prior-year FY9/24 paid ¥67/share. Increase reflects upward revision of net income forecast to ¥2,277M (+¥187M from prior guidance). Payout ratio implied ~32%. Effective FY9/25 year-end, single interim payment at period close.
title_en: Notice of Revision of Full-Year Business Forecast and Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase) for FY9/25
translation_en_brief:
Paraca Inc. announced on 16 July 2024 that its Board of Directors resolved to raise the full-year dividend forecast for FY9/25 (year ending 30 September 2025) from ¥70 per share to ¥72 per share—an increase of ¥2 per share (2.9%). The prior fiscal year (FY9/24) paid ¥67 per share.

The dividend increase is driven by an upward revision of the net income forecast to ¥2,277M, a gain of ¥187M from prior guidance. The revision reflects a special gain of approximately ¥870M from the sale of fixed assets in Sapporo, partially offset by provisions for impairment losses and challenges from newly opened parking facilities and severe winter weather. The company's stated capital allocation policy balances reinvestment with shareholder distributions based on capital efficiency, financial soundness, and investment environment.

Under the revised dividend structure, the full ¥72 per share will be paid at the fiscal year-end (no interim distribution), implying a payout ratio of approximately 32% on the revised earnings guidance.
